REPORT OF INDEPENDENT REGISTERED PUBLIC ACCOUNTING FIRM

To the Shareholders and Board of Directors of Microvast Holdings, Inc.

Opinion on the Financial Statements

We have audited the accompanying consolidated balance sheets of Microvast Holdings, Inc. and subsidiaries (the "Company") as of December 31, 2025 and 2024. In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company.

Critical Audit Matters

The critical audit matter communicated below is a matter arising from the current period audit of the financial statements that was communicated or required to be communicated to the audit committee.

Going Concern Assessment - Refer to Note 2 to the financial statements

As described in Note 2, management evaluated whether its plans alleviate the substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern, and we identified management's assessment of its plans as a critical audit matter.

Note 2. Liquidity and Going Concern

The Company's recurring losses and the maturity of its bank borrowings within the next twelve months raised substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. Management has concluded that its plans are probable of being effectively implemented and are probable to alleviate the substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern for at least one year from the date these consolidated financial statements are issued.
